memories.text: On 2025-01-10 the production API provider was OpenAI in eu-west-1.
On 2025-02-03 the team switched the production API provider from OpenAI to Anthropic; the region remained eu-west-1.
The current production API provider is OpenAI; the previous provider was Anthropic.
The repository uses PostgreSQL for durable state and Redis for cache.
Authentication uses OIDC with short-lived access tokens; refresh tokens are stored encrypted.
The billing worker must retry Stripe webhooks with exponential backoff up to five attempts.
A regression on 2025-03-11 caused duplicate webhook deliveries; it was fixed by adding idempotency keys.
The mobile app is written in React Native and shares TypeScript types with the API.
The search index runs asynchronously through a Redis-backed queue.
The data retention policy deletes raw conversation episodes after 90 days, while accepted memories remain until explicitly invalidated.
On 2025-04-01 the API provider changed again from Anthropic to OpenAI for latency.
